name: Hazuki Suina
source:
Affiliation: Hazuki Private School 2nd year, Group A (Formerly: Satsuki Academy) / Newspaper Club
Favorite food: Strawberry chocolate
Gift: Logical Dash (the ability to see the future, but this future prediction is based on what would “logically” happen in the future)

Suina is the president of the newspaper club and the daughter of the headmaster of the school. In her Route, she was selected as one of the 3 candidates for the World President Election. Joining the newspaper club the easiest plan [url=/c10120]Kyuushiro[/url] can think of, because the girls in this school are acquainted to him, and the more likely easier it is to manipulate them.

She's suspicious of Kyuushiro's actions. Back in their Satsuki school days, Suina was already in love with Kyuushiro and because of that, she tended to read into Kyuushiro’s future, and after [url=/c10095]Hikari’s[/url] arrival, she was not able to see into his future anymore.

[From [url=http://visualnovelspam.blogspot.fi/2013/08/hyperhighspeedgenius-thoughts.html]Visual Novel Spam[/url]]
